changelog: - An invited affiliate partner can choose its own referral code on the registration form: the current code is pre-filled, "Suggest another" draws a random unambiguous 8-character code, and availability is checked while typing through `POST /api/invite/partner-code` (token holder only, rate-limited, never names the holder). `/api/register` writes `partnerCode` with the account link (`linkPartnerAccount`, 409 `code_taken` / 400 `code_invalid` / 409 `code_locked`), audited as `affiliate.partner.code_chosen`. The code is fixed once the account exists or the code is in use (`partnerCodeLock()`) (#3961).

en: Invited partners can now choose their own referral code when they sign up — with a warning if it is already taken.
tr: Davet edilen partnerler artık kayıt olurken kendi referans kodlarını seçebiliyor; kod alınmışsa uyarı görüyorlar.
de: Eingeladene Partner können ihren Empfehlungscode jetzt bei der Registrierung selbst wählen – mit Hinweis, wenn er schon vergeben ist.
